reasons: Covers all messages and story titles in both languages.
Checks placeholders and numbers, which are the most common translation errors.
Checks unknown language codes are rejected.

terms.meaning: A marker in a message, such as pts in curly braces, that is replaced with a real value when shown.
A language and region setting, such as English or Hindi, that decides which text is shown.
A short headline the app builds from match facts, such as a turning point in a game.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports translation and title tools
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the translation helpers, the list of languages and the story title definitions.
sections.why: Likely reason: the tests need the same functions the app uses, so they check the real code.
sections.watch_out: The tests use the exported story title list, so renaming that export would break these tests.

sections.name: English and Hindi (i18n)
sections.title: Checks English and Hindi stay matched
sections.what: Checks every message exists in both languages with the same placeholders, that filling placeholders works and unknown ones stay visible, that only English and Hindi are supported, and that every story title exists in both languages with the same numbers. Also checks two Hindi grammar forms for the number of balls.
sections.why: Likely reason: a missing or mismatched translation would show blank or wrong text to Hindi readers.
sections.watch_out: Placeholders and numbers must match exactly across languages. A translator who reorders them or changes a digit will fail the tests.

summary: Tests that the English and Hindi messages and story titles stay in sync, with the same placeholders and numbers in both.
purpose: Stops a translation from missing a message, dropping a placeholder, or changing a number, which would show wrong or blank text to users.
why: Likely reason: the app is bilingual, so a mismatch would show users broken or wrong text.
how: Checks that every English message has a Hindi version and that placeholders such as the pts placeholder match in both. Checks the fill-in function and that only English and Hindi are supported. Checks story titles exist in both languages and keep the same numbers.
inputs: Message keys and story title functions from the app, with sample values such as points and team names.
outputs: Pass or fail results. No files or database are changed.
risks: Translators who reorder or change placeholders or digits will fail the tests. This is intended, but it can slow updates.
debug: If a test fails, the message key is printed. Compare the English and Hindi text for that key, and check that placeholders match exactly.
